head: e1239b1129841a51519450163463959fc8d0154f
title: fix(auth): remove private onboarding and client caches before account switches
body:
## HUNT-08-124 (agent 124) — T4

Three ordinary sequential-account privacy/data-integrity failures:

- B-08-1: A client completes onboarding and logs out; the next client on the phone skips optional metrics and receives the previous person's health answers in their own saved profile.
- B-08-2: A coach opens a client and logs out; another coach signs in and sees the first coach's client names/email in the Recent picker.
- B-08-3: A client saves Day-1 progress offline and later logs out; the next account resumes the previous person's goals and can replay their pending preferences into its own profile.

## Fix

Add the three raw AsyncStorage keys to the existing awaited sign-out sweep. These keys are outside MMKV and therefore were not covered by `clearAllStorage()`. No API, payload, dependency, navigation, permissions or server changes.

155 changed lines including tests; six implementation lines.

## Failing-first proof

Test-only commit `cc9527638ba1be3b25be4d19f7607e83fa63977c` precedes the fix.
Baseline CI lane: https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37522150429

The baseline has four expected behavioral failures and one passing same-account persistence control. The suite checks actual saved answers, profile payload fields, Recent rows, pending Day-1 writes, and deletion before logout. Same-account stored progress survives until logout; unrelated raw appearance settings survive logout.

The PR's own CI supplies typecheck/lint/full Jest and CodeQL. No additional lane beyond the one red baseline.

## Review and owner steps

Dual exact-head T4 review required. No dashboard-only fix or owner decision for this slice.
No production writes, signup, payment-provider calls, deployments, runner cancellation or dependency changes.
